about_docsText.message: Documentation, the privacy policy and the terms of use live in the public repository:

about_privacyText.message: ImgFetch has no server and collects nothing. Only the images you choose to download are fetched, and Google Lens (only if you click it) opens Google with the image address. See PRIVACY.md in the repository for the full statement.

pr_desc.message: ImgFetch keeps everything on your device. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics.

pr_stores1.message: Your settings, site preferences, and download history live in your browser's local storage, on this device only.

pr_stores2.message: Downloaded images go straight to your Downloads folder. ImgFetch never uploads them anywhere.

pr_never1.message: No accounts and no sign-in, there is nothing to log into.

pr_never2.message: No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting.

pr_never3.message: No remote code, every script ships inside the extension package.

pr_never4.message: Images are fetched directly from the sites you visit, using your normal browser session. ImgFetch adds no tracking parameters.

pr_permNote.message: Why ImgFetch asks for each permission is explained in the About section, and the full statement is PRIVACY.md in the public repository.
pr_permNote.description: Privacy: note pointing at the About section.
